svg.aria-label: Ten source databases pass through per-source preparation scripts into derivative CSV tables; GSHP, KSSL, Hohenbrink, Zanjanrood, Arizona, the Canary Islands, the restricted EU-HYDI and the unpublished Laikipia form the default merged reference of 20,052 layers, with UNSODA and sDB added only in the all set.
